themes.name: Server attitude and attentiveness
themes.description: How waiters, servers and bartenders treated guests, including friendliness, rudeness, knowledge of the menu, checking in, refills, and being ignored or rushed.

themes.name: Hostess and seating policy
themes.description: Interactions with the host stand, including attitude, whether walk-ins, parties or solo diners were seated, table assignments, and enforcement of reservation or full-party rules.

themes.name: Wait times and pacing
themes.description: Time spent waiting for a table, drinks, food or the check, and how the meal was paced, including dishes arriving too fast, out of order, or plates cleared early.

themes.name: Reservations and crowding
themes.description: How hard it is to get a reservation or table, how busy the restaurant is, and whether guests recommend booking ahead.

themes.name: Price and portion value
themes.description: Whether the cost of dishes, drinks and the overall bill matches the portion sizes and quality of the food.

themes.name: Saltiness and seasoning
themes.description: Comments on how well dishes were seasoned, including food described as too salty, bland, or lacking flavor.

themes.name: Wood-fired oysters
themes.description: Opinions on the signature wood-fired or grilled oysters with chili garlic butter, including their sauce, size, count per order and pairing with bread.

themes.name: Fried alligator
themes.description: Opinions on the fried alligator appetizer, including its texture, tenderness, chili garlic mayo sauce and how it compares to chicken.

themes.name: Louisiana Cochon entree
themes.description: Opinions on the signature Louisiana Cochon pork dish with cabbage, cracklins and pickled peaches, including its moisture, flavor, saltiness and temperature.

themes.name: Rabbit and dumplings
themes.description: Opinions on the rabbit and dumplings dish, including the rabbit meat, the dumplings or biscuits, the stew base and how it compares to chicken pot pie.

themes.name: Pork cheeks, ribs and ham hock
themes.description: Opinions on pork dishes other than the Cochon entree, such as braised pork cheeks, smoked ribs with watermelon pickle, ham hock and pork belly.

themes.name: Boudin and small plates
themes.description: Opinions on starters and small plates such as fried boudin balls, fried chicken livers with pepper jelly, the boucherie plate, gumbo and crawfish pie.

themes.name: Sides and mac and cheese
themes.description: Opinions on side dishes, including macaroni and cheese casserole, grits, greens, lima beans, eggplant and shrimp dressing and twice-baked potato.

themes.name: Bread and rolls
themes.description: Comments on the complimentary rolls and bread basket, including their quality and whether tables received them or had to ask.

themes.name: Desserts
themes.description: Opinions on desserts such as pineapple upside down cake, butterscotch pudding, pies, cakes and bread pudding.

themes.name: Cocktails and drinks
themes.description: Opinions on the cocktails, moonshine, whiskey, beer and wine list, including drink quality, size and selection.

themes.name: Noise and seating comfort
themes.description: Comments on how loud the dining room is, how closely tables or benches are packed, and the comfort of chairs and temperature.

themes.name: Atmosphere and decor
themes.description: Comments on the look, vibe and design of the space, including the open kitchen, chef's counter seating, trendy or hipster feel and lighting.

themes.name: Hype and expectations
themes.description: Whether the restaurant lived up to its reputation, awards, reviews and recommendations, including comparisons to other New Orleans restaurants and to Cochon Butcher next door.

themes.name: Cleanliness and food safety
themes.description: Concerns or praise about cleanliness, including dirty restrooms or glassware, pests, foreign objects in food, and illness after eating.

themes.name: Dietary accommodations
themes.description: How well the kitchen handled vegetarians, allergies, special requests, substitutions and menu variety for guests with restrictions.
